procedure.name: Класифікація файлів/процесів
procedure.description: Read-only Seiri classification before any cleanup plan

changes.what: Necessary, conditional, cleanup-candidate, and forbidden classifications
changes.why: Create source-backed evidence before deciding whether a Seiso plan is needed
changes.how: seiri_sort_analyze followed by operator review; no removal in Seiri

validation_steps: Review every classification and policy reason
Confirm no state-changing tool was called
Route approved cleanup candidates to a new Seiso plan
